text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — for the longform dialogue bring-up (quant experiments + evals) I'm proposing a trimming rulebook so our promptset stays consistent across models. rough idea below, please react with objections or edgecases.

Maria Chen: proposed trim rules:
```
trim_rules:
  head_turns: 5    # keep the first 5 turns
  tail_turns: 3    # keep the last 3 turns
  min_tokens: 256  # if total tokens < 256 keep full convo
  preserve_speakers: true  # keep speaker labels intact
```

Jonathan Park: +1 on having rules. one ask: for multi-party chats (3+ participants) we should prefer keeping at least one full participant's recent turns so context for that speaker isn't lost. maybe head_turns -> per-speaker-head when participants>2?

Lee Rivera: agree with jonathan. also a dedupe note — run convo-level embedding fingerprinting before trimming. I suggest threshold 0.82 to avoid chopping near-duplicates into different buckets.

Anna K: labeling ops: trimmed dialogs need new golden labels. we'll need a relabel batch for anything where the trimmed dialog removed the answer or the key QA turn. propose sampling 2k dialogs stratified by domain for manual relabel.

Maria Chen: ETA request for relabel volume? how long to get gold back if we kick off today?

ingest-bot: automated: started job dedupe-trim/1709876543 id=job-jk23. queued 14,200 convos. estimated runtime 3.2 hours. updates in #eng-ml when finished.

Jonathan Park: for evals keep a small holdout of untrimmed long dialogs to stress-test latency and attention-cache behavior — suggest 500 samples, flagged as LONG_UNTRIMMED_HOLDOUT in metadata.

Lee Rivera: quantization concern: trimmed inputs shift token-length distribution. recommend rerunning the quant smoke (qsmoke) with prefix KV-cache warmup disabled to catch regressions that are length-sensitive. also add a metric for "answer truncation rate" to regression dashboards.

Anna K: labeling checklist for the relabel batch:
- mark if trimming removed critical QA pair (yes/no)
- label hallucination / factuality for preserved turns
- flag ambiguous turn boundaries (needs reviewer escalation)
- note that thread-level dedupe id must be carried over to new gold rows

Maria Chen: I'll update the promptset docs and upload the new gold CSV to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/g/longform-gold/trim-jun24 (placeholder link). I'll include columns: original_length_tokens, trimmed_length_tokens, dedupe_id, holdout_flag.

Jonathan Park: please add original_length_tokens — important for analyzing latency vs accuracy trade-offs.

Lee Rivera: can someone drop a tiny CLI wrapper for local testing? e.g. minimal command to reproduce trimming locally so model engineers can reproduce exact inputs.

Maria Chen: quick snippet I'm going to add to tooling repo:
```
python -m tooling.trim_dialogs --head 5 --tail 3 --min-tokens 256 
  --in input.jsonl --out trimmed.jsonl
```

Anna K: I'll schedule the labeler batch for tomorrow morning. SLA requested: 72h for the 2k relabel, flag any domain-specific slowdowns.

Maria Chen: one more: we should update the eval harness to compare trimmed-model vs untrimmed-holdout on quality and latency. jonathan can you own eval harness changes?

Jonathan Park: yep, I'll add an eval job and a baseline column for UNTRIMMED_METRIC. will also add a small script to compute answer-truncation-rate from model outputs.

Lee Rivera: +1. also keep an eye on tokenization differences after quantization (some tokenizers treat long-form punctuation differently) — add tokenizer sanity checkpoint in pipeline.

Maria Chen: great — thanks. next actions: 1) ops runs dedupe-trim job (ingest-bot) 2) anna confirms labeler batch + SLA 3) jonathan adds eval harness changes 4) lee adds quant smoke notes + tokenizer check 5) I update doc and upload gold. I'll post final rulebook once dedupe run finishes. :thumbsup:

Anna K: noted — will ping once labeler batch is scheduled.

ingest-bot: automated: dedupe-trim/1709876543 progressed to 35% (ETA ~2h 6m).

Maria Chen: thanks all — will reconvene after the dedupe job completes.
